svg.title: Epithelial row
svg.desc: Original OpenSketch flat schematic. Independent vector parts; use the Scientific structures palette for path editing.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(37,73,75); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-dashoffset: 0; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-miterlimit: 4; fill: rgb(216,239,233); fill-rule: nonzero; opacity: 1;
